none: PAS GLO-D4C595: Lead hexagonal standing weight
contea di ritrovamento: Gloucestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Lead hexagonal standing weight that has been inscribed of a possible roman date. On three if the sides are engraved letters IXIA/XIX/EW. The objects look at though it has a hollow core (now encrusted in mud) with the remains of an iron loop at the top. height 38mm, width 18.5mm, thickness 20mm, weight 59.68g
